column3: ## References are displayed on the article page

column1: Depends on Article References : Article References : Preparation

column3: Open the public article page for the article "References!" as an anonymous user

column4: A "References" section with the heading "References" is shown
The 4 references are shown as a numbered list, in the same order as in the uploaded file

column3: Check the first reference, which contains the DOI "10.1234/abc"

column4: The DOI is displayed as a link
Clicking the link opens https://doi.org/10.1234/abc in a new tab

column3: Check the second reference, which contains the URL "https://www.doaj.org/"

column4: The URL is displayed as a link
Clicking the link opens the URL in a new tab

column3: Check the third reference, which contains no DOI and no URL

column4: The reference is displayed as plain text with no links

column3: Check the fourth reference, which contains the text "markup"

column4: The reference text is displayed exactly as it was supplied: Taylor, C. (2023) A reference with markup in it.
No part of the reference is rendered as italics, and no part of the page layout is broken

column3: Open the public article page of an article which has no references (e.g. an article uploaded from "successful.xml")

column4: No "References" heading and no reference list is shown on the page
